workshops.lede: Each workshop covers one topic with hands-on practice. Here’s how we plan to run them once we launch. Nothing is running or booking yet.
workshops.priceLede: Book us for a workshop, or run the activities yourself with a monthly plan. These are planned prices, and nothing is booking yet.
workshops.inPersonP: We come to you with the supplies. Up to 30 students per session.
workshops.w50p: One topic, hands-on. Fits in a class period or after school.
workshops.w90p: More hands-on time, or two topics in one session.
workshops.series: Series or family day. Several topics over a few weeks, or a day where students and families learn together. Priced per session.
workshops.monthlyP: New activities and printable guides every month. You run them with your students, on your schedule.
workshops.teacherP: For teachers, volunteers and group leaders who show proof.
workshops.teamP: One plan shared by you and up to two other teachers or staff.
workshops.first: Who goes first. Schools and groups that serve low-income families get the first spots.
workshops.sesLede: Here’s the 50-minute version, which fits in a class period or after school. The 90-minute one adds more practice time.
workshops.openP: Start with real life. Students talk about a time they ran into the problem or saw someone handle it. It gets everyone thinking before anyone picks up a tool.
workshops.showP: Watch it done. A mentor shows the skill step by step, explains why each step matters, and points out common mistakes.
workshops.practiceP: Try it yourself. Students practice in small groups with real tools and materials while mentors help. Mistakes are expected.
workshops.debriefP: Wrap up. We talk about what was hard, when to stop and ask for help, and who to ask. Everyone takes home a card with the steps.
workshops.ageLede: Same topics, adjusted to what each age can safely do.
workshops.t1p: Short, simple tasks with lots of moving around.
t1l: Name tools and what they’re for
Spot a “you won a prize” message
Practice asking for help, out loud
workshops.t2p: More on their own, and more real-life decisions.
t2l: Tighten a screw, hang something level
Plan and track a weekend budget
workshops.t3p: Planned for later, after we launch for grades 3 to 8.
workshops.hostP: A room with tables, a group of students, and an adult who knows them and stays for the session.
workshops.bringP: Lesson plans, tools, supplies, safety rules and take-home cards.
workshops.leadP: Our team runs the session with your staff in the room.
workshops.ctaH: Want this for your students someday?
workshops.ctaP: Join the interest list and tell us about your students. We’ll email you when we launch.
